reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts, rather than reimplementing the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the rule is resolved by the one shared function.

placement.why: Computed in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated list type. That is reasonable and keeps toExternal unchanged for the other endpoints, though the mapping could arguably sit in api-models next to scheduleModel.

scope.why: The diff only adds the field, its type and test expectations.

maintainability.why: A small, explicit change; the expected amount follows any future change to getScheduledAmount automatically.
